cover_headline: Mohammed Shami Retires From Test Cricket, Ending 64-Match, 229-Wicket Career
facts: He finished with 229 wickets in 64 Tests at an average of 27.71, with six five-wicket hauls and best figures of 6/56
Shami announced his decision on November 6, exactly 13 years after his Test debut at Eden Gardens
He will continue playing white-ball cricket, including the IPL and domestic cricket for Bengal

end.headline: Mohammed Shami Retires From Test Cricket, Ending 64-Match, 229-Wicket Career
end.line: Shami announced his decision exactly 13 years after his Test debut at Eden Gardens, saying he was leaving the white jersey but not its memories.

quote.text: I'm leaving behind the white jersey, but never the memories tied to it.
quote.speaker: Mohammed Shami
